output.reason: [ev-621f5e4bbeea] says Loki 3.0.0 removes the deprecated config `-s3.sse-encryption` in favour of the `-s3.sse.*` settings. The exposure cli-flag{-s3.sse-encryption, set} is the standard shape for a removed CLI flag, and it names exactly the flag in the evidence. One caveat: Loki may also accept this setting as a YAML config-file key, which this leaf would not catch. The evidence does not name any such key, so I cannot justify a broader condition.
